name: Shinglecoat
description: Shinglecoat carries its whole life on its back: grit, a fleck of shell, a chip of something blue that was probably a plate. It adds one piece at a time and never takes anything off again. Ask where any particular piece came from and you get the same slow blink you would get for any other question.
babyDescription: Bare-backed and self-conscious about it. Already carrying one grain of sand.
teenDescription: Half covered, and choosy in a way nobody else can predict.
adultDescription: Wearing eleven years of small findings, and still looking.

history.change: palette: baseColor #AE9679 -> #B39D7E, clearing wickroot at dE00 9.8. W64-ROSTER wants dE00 >= 10 between any two species; this is the smallest move that clears 11 against all 31 others.
